testcase.name: bir51_tc_insurance_rbc
testcase.description: BIR51 TC — Insurance Corporation, RBC Regime

variation.name: bir51_tc_insurance_rbc
variation.description: A valid BIR51 tax computation for an insurance corporation commencing implementation of the risk-based capital (RBC) regime. InsuranceCorporationCommencing...RBC = true, with exactly one of the two one-off RBC adjustment amounts non-zero (the other must be zero — NVAD-E-1095), and ElectToTreat...By5EqualAmounts tagged.
